question: Model-free measures from audio, references and kept hypotheses: VAD cost and cut placement, silence compaction, chunk peak levels and the auto-gain no-op, reference lengths, prompt-arm and voxtral-v1 text counts, clamped cues, and the min_cut threshold sweep
note: In the commands $PY is the repo venv python, $CLIP the 935s clip (bench_out/corpus_timed/632a295d981d.wav), $REF its reference subtitles (the .srt beside it) and $D the queue directory bench_out/q7_20261015; hypotheses are not saved. The derive_*.py scripts are written into $D/derive by the queue file's heredocs (not yet in the repo); they load no model and print counts keyed by file id. mincut_sweep rescores the hypotheses kept by the saved ultra-mincut-inputs runs.
